subject.title: Model configuration accepts unvalidated model names, enabling silent misconfiguration

question: Should unknown configured model refs be reported as warnings or hard validation errors, and which catalog source is authoritative for custom, proxy, and forward-compatible provider models?
rationale: Current config intentionally allows configured and future model refs, so adding broad catalog validation can improve reliability but may break valid custom/provider workflows without maintainer-chosen semantics.

options.title: Warn in validate and doctor
options.body: Surface unknown refs as actionable warnings using the runtime-equivalent catalog while preserving custom and forward-compatible configs as runnable.

options.title: Fail closed on unknown refs
options.body: Reject unknown configured refs during validation, accepting compatibility risk for users with custom provider catalogs or newly released upstream models.

options.title: Fold into model reconcile work
options.body: Defer this narrow guardrail into a broader model configuration reconcile/reset design so validation, migration, and session repair land together.

recommendation.title: Warn in validate and doctor
recommendation.body: Surface unknown refs as actionable warnings using the runtime-equivalent catalog while preserving custom and forward-compatible configs as runnable.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent is the strongest current-main routing candidate for the validation, doctor, and status surfaces inspected here.
